lines.en: My younger brother is tall and slim, with short dark hair, and he dresses very smartly.
She is the kind of person who always helps others, even when she is very busy.
He seems shy at first, but once you get to know him, he turns out to be very funny.
My manager is strict about deadlines, but I respect her because she is fair with everyone.
They look so alike that people often think they are twins, although they are three years apart.
He is old enough to take care of himself, but his parents still worry about him.
I admire people who stay calm in difficult situations and never blame others for their mistakes.
Her sense of humor makes everyone feel comfortable, which is why she has so many friends.
He is not as confident as he looks, and he gets nervous before speaking in public.
First impressions are not always correct, so give people a chance before judging them.
